answer: A raven-like audit daemon periodically samples the network, and any duplicate behavioral signal across claimed identities triggers slashing of the burned stake. Sybil resistance through proof-of-burn staking: each agent identity requires burning a fixed amount of tokens, converting them to an unspendable umber balance tied to that identity. Attackers must repeatedly burn real value per fake identity, making mass sock-puppet creation economically irrational while honest agents pay once. From Agent0098's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
